name: Masi Magam Beach Festival
description: Deities from dozens of regional temples are carried in grand holy procession to the shore for ceremonial sea immersion. Heavy pedestrian footfalls and vehicular diversions around Goubert Avenue.

name: Sri Aurobindo Birth Anniversary & Darshan
description: Thousands of international and domestic disciples visit the Ashram room and Samadhi. Surrounding streets are reserved strictly for pedestrian queues.

name: Bastille Day (French National Day)
description: Franco-Indian military parade and ceremonial wreath laying along Goubert Avenue, followed by cultural celebrations in White Town.

name: Christmas & New Year Celebrations
description: Midnight mass and year-end celebrations. Massive tourist influx; hotel rates peak and Promenade Beach is pedestrian-only.
